subject: SIG questionnaire: request for v2 change log and re-answers
messages:
From: Alice Newman <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Chen <b.chen@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: SIG v2 rollout: change log + re-answers request

Hi Karthik,

We received notice from Acme's audit team that the SIG schema has been updated (SIG v2.0) and they need updated answers from vendors. Your previous submission (v1) is on file, but the audit requires:

- A short change log indicating what answers changed between your last submission and this one (v1 -> v2).
- Re-answered questionnaire in the v2 format (PDF or CSV).
- A machine-readable diff (CSV preferred) for automated ingestion.

Priority: the audit team would like these by 2026-05-25 EOD. Please call out any control changes that materially increase risk or remove a control. If you plan to redact production retention details, we need an attestation that the redaction is for commercial reasons only and that full evidence can be provided under NDA.

Can you confirm scope and whether you will provide a signed attestation?

Thanks,
Alice Newman
Senior Information Security Analyst
Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

Subject: Re: SIG v2 rollout: change log + re-answers request

Alice — thanks for the heads up. Looping in Security (Marissa), Product (Laura), and Ops (Dev) to scope the workload.

Quick answers:
- We can produce the v2 answers and a CSV diff.
- We expect only a small number of substantive answer changes (control clarifications, retention mapping).
- We can provide an attestation; please confirm whether Acme needs DocuSign or a PDF signed by our CISO.

We'll aim to deliver a first draft (diff + draft answers) by 2026-05-22 EOD. If anything is material, we'll flag earlier.

-Karthik

Hi Alice / team —

Attaching our draft deliverables for initial review:
- SIG_v2_answers_redwood_draft_20260521.pdf (draft answers; marked where wording changed)
- SIG_v2_change_log.xlsx (row-per-question change log: v1_answer -> v2_answer, reason)

Notes / open items:
1) Q3.2.1 (data retention mapping) — our v2 answer references an internal retention class ("P90-prod"). We can either supply the full retention mapping (incl. production buckets) or provide a redacted view for vendor-facing docs and supply full evidence under NDA.
2) Q5.4.2 (incident response cadence) — we updated the answer to specify quarterly tabletop cadence for dedicated customers; that is a clarification rather than a control change.
3) No controls were removed; one control (config drift detection) has an expanded note about automation we added to be clearer.

Attachments: [attachment: SIG_v2_change_log.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [attachment: SIG_v2_answers_redwood_draft_20260521.pdf (pdf)]

If Acme's audit team wants production-level evidence for retention, let us know and we will route through Legal for a limited-scope NDA.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

From: Alice Newman <security@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bob Chen <b.chen@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v2 rollout: change log + re-answers request

Marissa — thanks for the draft. Quick clarifications from the audit team:

- For Q3.2.1 we do need production retention details for our evidence intake; redaction is acceptable in the vendor-facing PDF only if full evidence can be made available to our auditors under NDA. Please plan for both.
- For any answer that now specifies cadence or SLAs (e.g., Q5.4.2), we need a short one-line justification for why the change is only a clarification (not a control weakening).
- The audit team prefers a CSV diff (question_id, v1_answer, v2_answer, change_type) in addition to the spreadsheet. Can you supply that?

Also, can you indicate whether this update should be treated as a re-assessment (i.e., we need a new vendor risk rating) or a maintenance update? That will determine whether the evidence goes into the active audit queue.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alice Newman
Senior Information Security Analyst
Acme Corp

On Fri, May 21, 2026 at 1:45 PM Alice Newman <security@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> Marissa — thanks for the draft. Quick clarifications from the audit team:
>
> - For Q3.2.1 we do need production retention details for our evidence intake; redaction is acceptable in the vendor-facing PDF only if full evidence can be made available to our auditors under NDA.
> - For any answer that now specifies cadence or SLAs (e.g., Q5.4.2), we need a short one-line justification for why the change is only a clarification (not a control weakening).
> - The audit team prefers a CSV diff (question_id, v1_answer, v2_answer, change_type) in addition to the spreadsheet. Can you supply that?

Hi Alice — thanks, all. Attached are the finalized artifacts you requested:

- SIG_v2_answers_redwood_20260522.pdf (vendor-facing PDF; production retention redacted)
- SIG_v1-v2_diff.csv (machine-readable diff: question_id, v1_answer, v2_answer, change_type)
- evidence_manifest_20260522.json (manifest listing evidence items available to auditors under NDA)

Summary of changes (high level):
- Q3.2.1: v1 was a generic retention statement; v2 clarifies mapping to our retention classes. We redacted production bucket names in the public PDF but included full mapping in evidence_manifest_20260522.json for auditors under NDA. (change_type: clarification)
- Q5.4.2: clarified tabletop cadence to quarterly for dedicated customers; justification: operationalization of existing IR plan, no reduction in controls. (change_type: clarification)
- One editorial expansion for the config-drift detection control to clarify automated remediation steps. (change_type: editorial)

No controls were removed or materially weakened. We believe this should be treated as a maintenance update (no re-rating required) but will defer to Acme's risk team.

Attachments: [attachment: SIG_v2_answers_redwood_20260522.pdf (pdf)], [attachment: SIG_v1-v2_diff.csv (csv)], [attachment: evidence_manifest_20260522.json (json)]

Next steps:
- Please confirm whether Acme prefers a DocuSign attestation or a signed PDF. If DocuSign is preferred, here's our suggested URL for the signing packet: https://app.docusign.com/Example/Signing/ACME-ATTEST-2026
- If auditors need direct access to the evidence artifacts, we can initiate an NDA and provide a short-term signed S3 link.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-minute call if you want to walk through the diffs.

Best,
